title: At each wake the page writer lists comment threads awaiting its reply
why: An owner comment sent to Claude can sit unanswered for days: thread be1a03d4 waited 37 hours (Nov 10 22:05 to Nov 12 11:22 CST).
source: triage, 11:25 CST Nov 12, after the retrospective relayed the owner's 11:19 CST question
note: Incident: the owner's thread be1a03d4 (Nov 10 22:05 CST) on the claude-settings page got no reply until 11:22 CST Nov 12. At that point 19 of 52 threads were open, and 3 had the owner's comment as the last word. ArtifactComments read marks a thread "awaiting reply". Fix: skill waiting-page's wake routine reads the threads and puts each awaiting one in the writer's report under Input Needed until it is answered. A check reads the writer's report for a missing count. Cost: one comments read per wake, which already happens. Red case first. Ready, no lane.
